figure_candidates.label: Figure 1
figure_candidates.caption:
Fig. 1 | Overview of the engineering paradigm with dynamic synchronicity 
for multiple targets. SMARTS was developed by integrating a universal trigger 
module, an orthogonal stabilizer module and a fine-tuning multiplexer module, 
thereby enabling the conversion of transient signals from diverse quorum 
sensing into stable and multiplexed on or off outputs with varying strengths.

figure_candidates.caption:

molecules and receptors are from S. coelicolor M145, S. avermitilis MA-4680, 
S. ansochromogenes 7100 and S. coelicolor A3(2). The conserved DNA-binding  
site is indicated as a sequence logo. b, Phylogenetic tree of the EBDs from the

from S. avermitilis MA-4680, SabR1 (clade III) from S. ansochromogenes 7100 
and MmfR (clade IV) from S. coelicolor A3(2). c, Amino acid alignment of DBD

sequence of the artificial promoter Ptrig. Conserved DNA-binding site, −35 and

figure_candidates.caption:
Fig. 4 | Development of a fine-tuning multiplexer module. a, Illustration of the 
multiplexer module. It integrated three functional units: an amplification unit, 
a multiplexed on unit and a multiplexed off unit. b, Rare ECFs as an orthogonal

figure_candidates.label: Figure 5
figure_candidates.caption:
Fig. 5 | SMARTS-based optimization framework. a, Principle of the SMARTS-
based multiobjective optimization framework for secondary metabolite 
overproduction. The targets were categorized into two groups for consecutive 
collaborative optimization. Targets involved in synthetic machinery (group I)  
are represented by gears, while independent pathways are indicated by solid 
circles. b, Chemical structure of baiweimectin. c, Native and redesigned 
biosynthetic pathway of avermectins. MeiC was cloned from S. nanchangensis.  
d, Determination of the products of the engineered strains. The peak of 
avermectin B2a is highlighted in red; the peaks of other avermectin components 
are marked in gray. e, Group I targets coordinated for baiweimectin production. 
Sources and the corresponding reactions of the targets are annotated. PK, 
polyketide. f, Determination of the transcription strength of the three targets in 
group I. g, Baiweimectin titer of the resulting strain. h, Independent targets in
